% The same as test-priminput-ext.tex, by an absolute path:
% \input /<folder>/test-priminput/glossary.tex.
%
% Built as it is, \AbsDir is empty and the path is relative. run.mjs
% builds the page again with a test-priminput-abs-case.tex in TEXINPUTS
% that sets \AbsDir to the absolute path of test/fixtures/. As in the PDF,
% the file's text is in the page, with whether its path was absolute.
\documentclass{article}
\InputIfFileExists{test-priminput-abs-case}{}{\def\AbsDir{}}
\input \AbsDir test-priminput/glossary.tex
\begin{document}
Absolute: \primglossary{} By \ifx\AbsDir\empty a relative\else an absolute\fi{} path.
\end{document}
